answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ivory of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the canyon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vertex re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
